testcase.name: h05_receipt: the receipt re-derives its own hash from the fields it publishes
h05_receipt: the receipt identifier is derived from the hash
h05_receipt: the same repository yields the same receipt
h05_receipt: every declaring source is bound by its actual digest
h05_receipt: a changed registration set changes the receipt
h05_receipt: dropping a registration changes the receipt and widens the gap
h05_receipt: the gateway vocabulary is republished, not restated
h05_receipt: what is not observed is recorded rather than implied
h05_receipt: no event type is published as fully covered
h05_receipt: the holdout material observability never reads is named
h05_receipt: the projected bundle is bound by hash and is re-derivable
h05_receipt: the receipt records that the plugin manifest does not load it
h05_receipt: a changed projection changes the bundle hash and the receipt
h05_receipt: an observation envelope re-derives its own hash
h05_receipt: the observability module holds no clock and no randomness
h05_receipt: the receipt is canonical JSON and frozen
